chapters.title: Embeddings
chapters.blurb: A toy vector space where similar words cluster, cosines measure meaning, and king minus man plus woman really does land on queen.

chapters.title: Positional Encoding
chapters.blurb: Attention sees a bag of tokens — until each position gets a sinusoidal fingerprint added to its embedding, letting order ride along with meaning.

chapters.title: Multi-Head Attention
chapters.blurb: Three attention heads read the same sentence and find three different relations — position, reference, and description — then mix back into one stream.

chapters.title: The Residual Stream
chapters.blurb: One vector per token rides a highway through the whole model — each block just reads it, computes a small edit, and adds it back.

chapters.title: Sampling
chapters.blurb: Real softmax distributions over one prompt show how temperature, seeded sampling, and top-k turn a column of scores into the model's next word.
